fields.name: selected_target
fields.description: Store one [y, x] point identifying the target on which the goal-named cube was placed at the goal-requested ordinal during the demonstration. Count completed placements onto targets chronologically, not frames, initial cube positions, flyovers, button presses, or the final release onto the unmarked central workspace. Identify a placement by lowering the carried cube onto a target and releasing it. Identify the physical target at the requested completed release, then follow its identity through the remainder of the demonstration into the first execution scene, including occlusion, large movements, and exchanges of positions with other targets. Use continuous trajectories and the motion of all targets to resolve identity, not proximity to the original release location or the final layout alone. Target movement does not change the placement ordinal. Store that physical target's center in the first execution scene as the canonical [y, x] point. If the requested placement or the selected target's identity cannot be established from the demonstration and first execution scene, write "unknown". Write this point at decision step #1 and retain it unchanged at every subsequent decision step.  e.g. [116, 163]
